name: CEO / payment-redirection fraud
description: Attacker impersonates senior executive (or supplier) and instructs payment to fraudulent account. Often after compromised email.

name: Invoice / supplier fraud
description: Fake supplier invoice paid; or genuine supplier's bank details intercepted and changed.

name: Card / e-commerce fraud
description: Stolen credentials or compromised card used for fraudulent purchase; chargeback liability.

name: Authorised push payment (APP) fraud
description: Customer socially engineered into authorising payment to fraudster. Reimbursement liability.

name: Money-mule account
description: Customer (knowingly or coerced) opens account that becomes conduit for stolen / illicit funds.

name: Insider misappropriation
description: Staff member with access to systems or cash diverts funds, falsifies records, or grants unauthorised credit.
